column1: # Stage manifest (design dev-loop.md section 3 and 6): what L3 expects of each Round base at the
# current stage. Columns are tab-separated; "-" means none.
# Stage "transport" (step 7): the original STL is lifted and written alone, with no supports. It
# is a transport test, not a print candidate. The checker has no rule measurement built yet, so it
# must report every rule H1 to H9 as unverified and the overall answer as unverified. Never "pass".
# When a rule gets its measurement, this file changes in the same commit; the runner never infers
# applicability from whichever checks happen to exist.
